entryDesc.DSS update: a review and update of your existing asbestos report, priced by building class (a baseline survey if there's no report yet); your first report, whether a new survey or a DSS update, is priced at your program's member rate if you sign before the work, and if you sign within 30 days of receiving it the difference is credited on your first program invoice
entryDesc.First pre-work check: one limited sampling visit or project-specific DSS on your next job in an older building, at the list price, so you see the report before you commit
entryDesc.Discovery call: a 30-minute call to scope your buildings or jobs and your project calendar

programValue: No program includes a report: reports are bought when a project needs one, at the member rate.
